description: This file defines the class 'bugzilladbInterface', which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for interacting with a Bugzilla database, including retrieving bug details, checking bug existence, and generating configuration templates.

classes.name: bugzilladbInterface
classes.description: A class for integrating Bugzilla issues into the testing framework, providing methods to retrieve and check bug statuses and IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets default resolved statuses, and configuration options.

methods.name: getissue
methods.description: Fetches bug details from the database given a bug ID.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a bug with the specified ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the given ID exists in the database.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the format of a bug ID.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration settings.
